name: Can I start construction on my home addition before the permit is approved?
description: No, starting construction without an approved permit is illegal and can result in fines, stop-work orders, and demolition requirements, causing costly delays.

mainEntity.name: Can I start construction on my home addition before the permit is approved?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you should not start construction on your home addition before the permit is officially approved and issued. Beginning work without a valid permit is illegal and can lead to significant penalties, including stop-work orders, fines, and the requirement to demolish unpermitted construction. This can create costly delays and legal issues. The process clarity is clear: always wait for permit issuance before commencing any work to ensure compliance and avoid complications. Hometelligent Inc. emphasizes this critical step with all clients.
